segments.text: A second-year student at Meirin Academy, she is the daughter of the Ayashiro Dojo. She has a calm and collected personality. She rarely gets emotional, and is known by those around her as a cool girl.
She aims to excel in both academics and sports, and excels in both studies and sports. She lost her mother to illness when she was young, and lives with her father.
In her young mind, she has been actively doing all the housework since she was a child, so as not to cause trouble for her father. As a result, she is able to do most housework without any problems.

Although she doesn't remember much, she admires her mother, who is kind and gentle, as told to her by her father. She has been trained by her father since she was a child, and is skilled enough to serve as a teacher. She is skilled enough to subdue men if their physiques are not too different.
People around her expect her to be a successful martial artist, but she has no intention of
pursuing that path.
If anything, she has seen many people injured in martial arts since she was a child, so she wants to work in a job that helps people, such as a doctor or nurse.
Her favorite thing is stuffed animals that are big enough to hold in both hands.
命凛学園２年生　綾城道場の娘。
穏やかで落ち着いた性格。
感情的になることは少なく、周囲からはクール系女子と言われている。
文武両道を目指していて、勉強もスポーツも優秀。
幼い頃に母を病気で亡くし、父と二人暮らし。
幼心に父親に迷惑をかけまいと、子供のころから家事全般を積極的にこなしてきた。
そのため、大抵の家事はそつなくこなせる。
あまり記憶は無いけれども、父から聞いた優しく穏やかな母に憧れを持っている。
幼い頃から父に鍛えられていて、師範代を務められる程の実力がある。
ある程度の体格差なら、男性相手でも取り押さえることができる実力がある。
周囲から格闘技の選手としての活躍を期待されたりするが、そちらの道に進む気は無い。
どちらかというと、幼い頃から格闘技で怪我をする人をよく見てきたため、医者や看護師など人を助ける仕事をしたいと考えている。
好きなものは、両手で抱えるくらい大きなぬいぐるみ。

A second-year student at Inochi Rin Academy.
She is the head of the handicraft club. She is a cheerful gal who likes trendy things.
However, she is also interested in traditional crafts, and is interested in beautiful and cute things regardless of trends.
At first glance, she seems frivolous, and in fact she is, but she is a very loyal person who cares for her friends. She is the type who cannot leave people in trouble alone.
She is good at sports, but not good at studying.
(She is the type who can do it if she tries, but she just doesn't do it.)
She was once saved by Suzune and Ran when she was being harassed by a group of delinquents, and since then she has become attached to them and has become their friend.
She has never studied martial arts, but she is influenced by kung fu movies, manga, anime, etc. and can imitate the forms.
Her parents are divorced and she now lives with her mother.
Her mother works in the advertising industry, and is busy working from early in the morning until late at night, and she often goes on business trips.
Although they don't spend much time together, their relationship is good.
She is actually interested in glass crafts, and is thinking of becoming a glass craftsman in the future.
命凛学園２年生　手芸部部長。
流行モノが好きな明るいギャル。
それでいて伝統工芸などにも興味があり、綺麗なもの・可愛いものは流行関係無く興味を示す。
一見軽そうで、実際軽めだが、義に厚く仲間を大事にする性格。
困っている人を放っておけないタイプ。
スポーツは得意だが、勉強は苦手。
（やればできるタイプだが、やらないだけ）
以前、大勢の不良に絡まれたところを涼音と蘭に助けてもらい、それ以来２人に懐き、友人になった。
特に格闘技等を習った事は無いが、カンフー映画やマンガ・アニメなどから影響を受けて型だけは真似できる。
両親は離婚していて今は母と２人暮らし。
母は広告業界で働いており、朝早くから夜遅くまで忙しく働いている上に出張も多い。
一緒にいる時間は少ないが関係は良好。
実はガラス工芸に興味があり、将来はそちらの職人を目指そうと考えている。

A second-year student at Meirin Academy. Self-proclaimed rival of Suzune.
Her parents are certified public accountants.
Her family is fairly well-off. She has a kind side and is easily deceived.
She has attended a karate dojo since she was young and is quite skilled.
She considers Suzune her rival.

Her parents wanted her to go to a different school, but she persuaded them to let her go to Meirin Academy so she could attend the same school as Suzune. She was drawn to her by Akina and joined the handicraft club with Suzune.
Since she is often with Suzune, she challenges her to a challenge whenever she gets the chance, but Suzune has always refused.
Her academic ability is almost the same as Suzune's.
She left her parents' home after enrolling in Meirin Academy and lives alone in an apartment. She is not very good at housework, and although she tries her best, she often makes mistakes.
Her favorite thing is shonen manga (she hides this from everyone). She likes the traditional approach of hard work, friendship, and victory, which is why she became obsessed with karate.
命凛学園２年生　自称・涼音のライバル。
親は公認会計士。家はそれなりに裕福。
お人好しの一面があり、騙されやすい。
幼い頃から空手道場に通っていて、相当な実力者。
涼音をライバル視している。
本当は親の希望で別の学園に行く予定だったが、涼音と同じ学園に通うため、親を説得して命凛学園に入学した。
晶奈に引き込まれる形で、涼音と共に手芸部に入部した。
涼音と一緒にいることも多いため、何かと機会を見ては涼音に勝負を持ちかけるのだが涼音からはずっと断られている。
学力は涼音とほぼ同等。
命凛学園への入学を機に親元を離れ、マンションで１人暮らしをしている。
家事はあまり得意ではなく、頑張っているがよく失敗をする。
好きなものは少年漫画（この事は、みんなには隠している）
努力・友情・勝利といった王道が好きで、空手にはまったのもそういう理由から。

A transfer student. A third-year student at Meirin Academy.
She lives with her younger sister, Miyuri.
She has a calm personality and appearance, and is serious.
She does everything well, and is trusted by her classmates and teachers.
She doesn't say much, and seems to keep a certain distance from the people around her. She
doesn't have any particular dreams for the future, and puts her younger sister Miyuri's happiness first.
Her favorite thing is shopping with her sister.
She doesn't buy many things for herself, but she buys things for her sister because she wants to see her sister's happy face.

When she was little, she lived near Suzune's parents' house and attended the Ayashiro Dojo. She was an all-around athlete and had a great fighting sense, and was expected to have a bright future in many areas.
She moved due to her parents' transfer, and since then she hasn't been in contact with Suzune.
転校生。命凛学園３年生。
妹の美百合と二人暮らし。
落ち着いた性格・容貌をしていて、真面目。
何事もそつなくこなし、同級生からも教師からも信頼されている。
口数は少ばく、周囲の人達とは一定の距離を取っている節がある。
将来の夢などは特になく、妹の美百合の幸せを最優先で考えている。
好きなことは、妹とのショッピング。
自分のものはあまり買わないが、妹の喜ぶ顔が見たくて色々と買い与えている。
小さい頃は涼音の実家近くに住んでいて、綾城道場に通っていた。
スポーツ万能なうえ格闘センスにも秀でていて、様々な面で将来を期待されていた。
親の異動の都合で引っ越し、それ以来涼音とは音信不通だった。

Transfer student. First year student at Meirin Academy.
Miori's younger sister.
Shy and quiet.
Shy, not good at talking to people, and has few friends.
Good at studying, always gets high grades.
On the other hand, she is physically weak, so she often watches PE classes.

Like Miori, she is also childhood friends with Suzune. She was physically weak when she was little, but thanks to training at the Ayajo Dojo with Suzune and Miori, she was able to get to school normally.
Miori has always protected her since she was little, so she wants to somehow repay her kindness.
転校生。命凛学園１年生。
美桜理の妹。
内気で大人しい性格。
人見知りで、自分から話しかけるのは苦手で、友達は少ない。
勉強は得意で、成績は常に上位。
その反面、身体が弱いので体育はよく見学している。
美桜理と同じく涼音とは幼なじみ。
小さい頃は身体が弱かったが、涼音・美桜理と一緒に綾城道場で稽古をしていたおかけで、普通に通学できる程度にはなれた。
小さい頃からずっと美桜理に守られてきたため、どうにか美桜理に恩返しをしたいと思っている。

President of an event management company. He mainly hosts martial arts events and
makes a huge profit from his underground business.
He has been involved in fights since he was young, and even participated in underground fighting matches.
One day, he got into a fight with Suzune's father, Yamato, and was completely beaten up.
This prompted him to switch to the management side, but the flame of revenge against Yamato continues to burn.

Takeo's only son. A first-year student at Meirin Academy. He has a selfish personality and thinks that most things can be solved with money and violence. He trains his body, but he also uses muscle-building supplements, making him quite muscular for a student. He is stronger than most and would be able to win a fight with someone his age, but he lacks the skills to fight properly against someone with martial arts experience.
A fighter.
At one time, he was a skilled fighter in the ring of a famous martial arts event, but
he was kicked out because his private life was a mess and his behavior was too bad.
At that time, he was scouted by Takeo, but since he couldn't handle it on the front stage,

he was hired as a fighter in an underground martial arts event. He has a strong sex drive, and especially after a match, he gets so excited that he can't calm down unless he ejaculates multiple times .
